label: Transfer the prefix likelihood calculation to randomized relay cuts
description: A successful cut response at depth d selects exactly the indices i ≥ d, the same summands as a prefix of length d selects in the supplier audit. Here the distribution is the investigator's choice of cut i and the depth d is fixed. The probability is positive exactly when the tail contains a positive weight, and it is at most the total mass one. The reused prefix result gives arbitrarily small tails at large depth and the exact geometric value. Relay-only outcomes contribute zero at every cut index.
